title: The afternoon sweep
prompt: It is 13:50 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: The same ideas apply outside the morning. Look at what price has taken by this point in the day, and what it did next.
intro.advanced: 13:50 ET. Afternoon. Mark what matters and decide.

whyNot.label: the bullish gap in the pullback
whyNot.why: It formed in the retrace, against the move down. A pullback is not a long.

whyNot.label: selling at market
whyNot.why: The edge is in the gap the displacement left. Selling after the move pays for it and puts the stop a leg away.

reference.summary: The day's high is swept in the afternoon, price displaces down through the last 5m low and retraces into the gap it left. The draw is the session low. Same model as the morning, in a different window.

bias.why: Lower highs and lower lows on the Daily and 4H; the session's rally was a retrace inside that downtrend.

decision.why: A sweep of the day's high, displacement and a retrace into the gap: a valid short, with a clear draw. Waiting for the retrace is equally sound.

take.why: Sweep, displacement, a defined entry and a draw.

draw.why: The session low, a long way below, is the pool.

annotations.label: Session low 20,160.5
annotations.why: The pool below and the draw: it's where the move is aimed.

annotations.label: 1H bearish FVG the sweep ran into
5m bullish FVG in the pullback
annotations.why: Against the move: it's the retrace.
annotations.whyNot: A gap against displacement is the pullback, not a setup.

confluences.label: It's the afternoon, not the open
confluences.why: The model doesn't care about the window.

trade.confirmationLabel: the displacement that closed below the last 5m low

lookFor: The same sequence works in any session: liquidity taken, displacement, retrace into the gap.
Know which high or low you're calling liquidity: the session's, not just the last bounce.

provenance.note: Constructed price path, not market history.
